verdict.rationale: Beamer's own docs say it can collect and prioritize feedback, and it gathers user comments, reactions and NPS responses. That implies a central place where feedback lands, but the evidence never describes a single searchable repository or intake of requests from internal colleagues. missing for 10: documented unified feedback/request repository, search capability, internal colleague request intake, aggregation across all channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access one searchable repository for all product requests and feedback from colleagues and customers

citations.quote: Now, you can easily collect and prioritize feedback—and know how to build more value into your product.
Collect user comments and reactions to see what people really think of your latest product updates.
it's easy to collect regular, actionable feedback and identify trends you can quickly act on
